Withdrawal returns min(fuel,5000) to new vial, but TileEntityRepeller.removeFuel subtracts the requested5000 rather than returned amount, so ordinary partial withdrawals can create negative fuel. Then fuel<0 clamps to0 and skips the entire entity/cost branch. Otherwise entity/cost branch runs even with fuel==0, running==false or missing stone. Hence nominal power qualification is not final control admission. The nested fuel>0/fuel<=0 branch is unreachable and does not pre-clamp zero. Server query uses current radius+5 AABB, actual center=(block+.5,+1.15,+.5). IMob targets except EntityWight and IBLBoss pass only if nearest of eight AABB corners has squared distance strictly less than radius squared. Before billing, call move(PISTON,diffX*.1,0,diffZ*.1), overwrite motionX/Z with unit-from-pre-move-position times ((radius-len)/radius*1.5+.5), and attempt SLOWNESS10 amp6 on LivingBase. No hurt call or native knockback attribute query. Cost contribution only when collidedHorizontally is false after the move call; movement/potion acceptance is not returned as an authoritative result. Independent if(IProjectile || EntityFireball), so mob exclusions do not globally guard this branch. Same corner gate, captures current speed then horizontal piston move and writes all motion components radial with that speed. IProjectile.shoot(radialUnit,1,1) follows and may replace the prior velocity; sets velocityChanged=true. Bills only if !collidedHorizontally && !collidedVertically && !onGround. No owner/acceleration/hit-set reset or impact cancel. Concrete/native shoot implementations not expanded; final speed/trajectory unproven. After processing all sampled targets, accumulatedCost += min(sumCost,.00125)*1000. Mob contribution .00028*(radiusState/1.5+1); projectile .0004*(radiusState/1.5+1). While accumulatedCost>1 (strict), subtract1 and fuel--. No pre-effect affordability, lower clamp or per-target dedup. At ordinary bounded residual, a cap-hit tick can charge two integer fuel; a zero-fuel residual field can go negative after effects. Native block update flag3 only if fuel consumed; markDirty every nonnegative-fuel branch. Both sides then reset deployTicks when prevRunning differs, set lastRadius and advance quintic easing. desiredRadius=4.5*(radiusState+1). Control already used the previous radius. Running extension feeds current radius as b and desiredRadius as c; stop/retraction feeds desiredRadius as b rather than the current operational radius, with c=-desiredRadius. Thus power-off residual radius is still operational, and stopping a partially deployed field can jump it near desired rather than shrink monotonically. No fixed 80-tick deployment-success claim because current radius is repeatedly fed back. Full tile NBT writes fuel/stone/deployTicks/radius/running/radiusState/accumulatedCost and raw-reads them; prevRunning=running, lastRadius not restored. Explicit update packet writes operational fields but omits accumulatedCost; receiver applies them and sets prevRunning without lastRadius. getUpdateTag first calls super then writes fields; inherited super serialization is not expanded, so do not say the tag excludes accumulatedCost. No custom per-target effect receipt/identity sequence. Native packet dispatch timing and tick after tile removal unverified. Actual ClientProxy binds RenderRepeller; isRunning returns running || radius>0, so render queues an interpolated sphere during residual phase, independent of any target effect/expense. ClientProxy registers WorldRenderHandler whose complete RenderWorldLast method consumes queued spheres via shader or fallback GL and clears the list on ordinary completion of that section. Shader enabled but unavailable nested resources need not fall back. Shine follows stone presence, model receives fuel ratio; neither is rejection proof. Directional render center is offset .12 from physical center. Independent block randomDisplayTick emits ambient animator paths. No actual model/texture assets read or changed. Stopping power does not clear radius or cost residue immediately. As stop easing reaches nonpositive radius it clamps0 and subsequent strict radius gate excludes ordinary targets. Negative-fuel ticks skip effects but still evolve radius. Missing support/top/bottom drives block teardown and ordinary parent break call; drops stone and plain repeller without copying fuel in this block method. Native tile destruction/invalidation internals and graphical/runtime correctness are outside evidence.
